objective: Compare search-only local-selector and full-block-output-selector alpha choices on identical native GPTQ candidates; held documents evaluate frozen choices and full alpha landscapes only.

quantization.alpha_1_semantics: unmodified native dynamic GPTQ; no range hook
quantization.candidate_implementation: existing v17.3 wrapper invoking installed GPTQModel native GPTQ core with its minimal dynamic range hook; no copied GPTQ implementation

data.selection: eligible complete articles sorted by SHA256(selection_domain + ASCII full_article_sha256); first 64
data.parser: v14/v15 full article parser; top-level article headings; semicolon headings excluded

prefix_and_teacher.prefix: the complete frozen v18 M2 dense checkpoint, including all quantized predecessor and sibling modules
prefix_and_teacher.prefix_refresh: capture one current M2 input per full document at each target block; refresh only by running the actual prior quantized blocks
prefix_and_teacher.capture_dependencies: one complete 24-layer M2 forward per document captures q_proj input and up_proj input at each frozen target layer; q/k/v share the attention input and up/gate share the MLP input; no per-row-batch prefix recapture
prefix_and_teacher.post_candidate_activation_refresh: none; each candidate is scored by one full target-block forward from the same cached block input, with no downstream candidate commit or refresh
prefix_and_teacher.teacher: pristine FP16 target decoder block evaluated on that exact frozen M2-prefix block input
prefix_and_teacher.student: same target block with the target Linear on the all-row local-M2 stitch; substitute one selected row candidate; every other module retains v18 M2 weights
prefix_and_teacher.downstream: real full decoder block output; q_proj traverses attention, o_proj, residual, MLP and block output; up_proj traverses gate/SwiGLU, down_proj, residual and block output

selection.local: argmin over search documents of direct Linear row output MSE X @ (Q_alpha-W)^T; exact tie selects larger alpha
selection.block: argmin over the same ten candidate row tensors of complete target block output MSE against the fixed teacher; search documents only; exact tie selects larger alpha
selection.native_reference: alpha=1 candidate row placed into the same search-selected all-row local-M2 stitched target; diagnostic intervention baseline, not whole-model M1
selection.held_rule: freeze local/block selected alpha before reading held losses; evaluate the same ten candidate rows on held block output for ranking/regret, plus native/local/block selected rows; no held choice or retuning
selection.stitching: only one preregistered row intervention at a time; never stitch held-selected rows

candidate_order: target cells L0 q, L0 up, L12 q, L12 up, L23 q, L23 up; within each, split A then B; alpha ascending 0.1 to 1.0

cost_gate.if_exceeded: E1_COST_GATE_FAIL and STOP before formal candidate landscape execution
